findings.message: Track 2 has 10 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: <div> binds data-var-text="line" but no variable "line" is declared in data-composition-variables, so the binding will silently keep the authored fallback.
findings.fixHint: Declare the variable on the composition root (<html>, or the [data-composition-id] root element for a template/fragment comp): data-composition-variables='[{"id":"line","type":"string","label":"line","default":"..."}]', or fix the binding id.

findings.message: <div id="endcard"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="endcard"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
